article.headline: Davion Everett scores 23 to lead South Carolina State over Coppin State 87-57
article.description: — Davion Everett scored 23 points to lead South Carolina State to an 87-57 romp over Coppin State on Monday night.
article.linkText: Davion Everett scores 23 to lead South Carolina State over Coppin State 87-57

categories.description: Coppin State Eagles @ South Carolina State Bulldogs

event.description: Coppin State Eagles @ South Carolina State Bulldogs

keywords: Coppin State Eagles @ South Carolina State Bulldogs
article.story: ORANGEBURG, S.C. -- — Davion Everett scored 23 points to lead South Carolina State to an 87-57 romp over Coppin State on Monday night. Everett added six rebounds for the Bulldogs (13-12, 6-3 Mid-Eastern Athletic Conference). Drayton Jones totaled 19 points and five rebounds. Jayden Johnson had 13 points. Jonathan Dunn led the way for the Eagles (4-20, 2-7) with 19 points. Julius Ellerbe added 15 points and six rebounds. Khali Horton added 10 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
